title: Two-step tandem synthesis of sugar-containing pyrimidine derivatives catalyzed by Lipozyme® TL IM in continuous-flow microreactors
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,38193-38199
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07120D, Paper
Open Access

Han-Jia Xie, Wen-Xuan Shao, Li-Hua Du, Ao-Ying Zhang, Hang Lin, Zong-Hao Huang, Guo-Neng Fu, Jia-Hong Shen, Bing-Lin Yan, Miao-Miao Xue, Lin Wang, Xi-Ping Luo
In continuous-flow microreactors, a two-step tandem scheme was developed to synthesize a series of sugar-containing pyrimidine derivatives with excellent regioselectivity, which can effectively avoid the separation and purification of intermediates.
